corrected.name: Roth.weight_le_card
corrected.source:
theorem weight_le_card {r : σ → ℕ} {d : σ →₀ ℕ} (hd : ∀ j, d j ≤ r j) :
    weight r d ≤ Fintype.card σ :=
  (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ ↦ div_le_one_of_le₀ (by exact_mod_cast hd j) (by positivity)).trans_eq
    (by simp)

corrected.what: A multi-index bounded coordinatewise by the parameters has weight at most the number of variables.
corrected.how: Bounds every summand by one using div_le_one_of_le₀, then sums the coordinatewise inequalities.
